overview: The Medford School Committee recognized student achievements, approved field trips and labor agreements, authorized filing an MSBA Statement of Interest for Medford High School, and voted to hold FY 2020 pre-budget hearings as a Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the February 11, 2019 meeting.

items.title: Approval of Bills and Transfer of Funds
items.summary: Approved bills and fund transfers following clarifications regarding adult education and student activity accounts.

items.title: Recognition of Tristan Howard
items.summary: Recognized high school track athlete Tristan Howard for state and regional championship accomplishments.

items.title: Ethics Bowl Report and Field Trip Approval
items.summary: Heard a presentation on the Ethics Bowl team's regional championship and approved a field trip to the national competition in North Carolina.

items.title: Scholastic Writing Awards Recognition
items.summary: Recognized three student recipients of Silver Key awards in the Scholastic Writing Competition.

items.title: Scholastic Art Awards Recognition
items.summary: Recognized three high school students awarded honors in the Scholastic Art Competition.

items.title: DECA Field Trip Approval
items.summary: Approved an overnight field trip for DECA students to attend the state competition in Boston.

items.title: Donation for Speech and Language Therapists
items.summary: Accepted a $177 donation from parent and teacher Elizabeth Gomez to cover registration for speech and language therapists to attend a stuttering conference.

items.title: Harlem Wizards Fundraiser Presentation
items.summary: Received a presentation on the Harlem Wizards basketball fundraiser organized by the Medford Citywide Elementary PTO.

items.title: Functions of the School Committee Document
items.summary: Adopted a final guiding principles document defining the roles and functions of the Medford School Committee.

items.title: Responsible Use Policy Update
items.summary: Accepted a subcommittee report on district technology policies and voted to add the current date to reflect that the policy is up to date.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on school community service projects, winter athletics, vocational programs, interim appointments, and upcoming events.

items.title: Kids' Corner Memorandum of Agreement
items.summary: Ratified a Memorandum of Agreement with Kids' Corner.

items.title: Secretary Memorandum of Agreement
items.summary: Ratified a Memorandum of Agreement with the secretaries' bargaining unit.

items.title: MSBA Statement of Interest for Medford High School
items.summary: Approved filing a Statement of Interest with the MSBA for building updates at Medford High School, amended to re-evaluate partner enrollment projections.

items.title: Pre-Budget Hearing Structure
items.summary: Voted to conduct upcoming FY 2020 pre-budget working sessions as a Committee of the Whole rather than in subcommittee.

items.title: History and Social Science Standards Report
items.summary: Received an update on implementation plans for the 2018 Massachusetts History and Social Science Framework and its civics requirements.
